body.statement: For \(d=2\), \(m=3\), \(B=0\), and \(Q=\operatorname{diag}(q_1,q_2)\succ0\), the matrices \(A=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}0&0\\a&0\end{smallmatrix}\right)\) and \(D=\operatorname{diag}(q_1,q_2-a^2q_1)\) belong to the compatible fiber for every \(|a|<\sqrt{q_2/q_1}\). Thus a queried lower edge has an open interval of attained transfer coefficients, and the certificate must return two interior witnesses rather than unattained endpoints.
body.justification: This is the destructive sanity check for singular odd-factor completeness.
body.gap: A regular-root recursion alone would incorrectly suggest odd-factor point identification at this collision.
body.consumer: It is an exact regression test for any implementation of the CAD fallback.
